measurementDefinitions.orderCounts: Counts are totals over five repetitions; aggregate orders and timely are daily averages.
measurementDefinitions.timeStatistics: Average, median, minimum and maximum pool all individual orders across repetitions.
measurementDefinitions.percent: 100 times total timely orders divided by total orders; deadline is request to completed delivery <= 75 minutes.
measurementDefinitions.utilization: Mean across repetitions of busy vehicle minutes inside the receiving window divided by fleet capacity in that window, times 100.
measurementDefinitions.overtime: Mean across repetitions of max(0, last vehicle return minus end of receiving window).
measurementDefinitions.orderHash: SHA256 of compact sorted-key JSON for ordered (identifier, arrival, destination) records; equal inputs across policies and fleet sizes within each season and seed.
